install: uv tool install graphifyy[mcp]==0.9.66; graphify install --project --platform claude inside the checkout copy (skill, PreToolUse hooks, CLAUDE.md nudge; archived as installed-dot-claude/)

build.command: claude -p "/graphify <copy of checkout> --no-viz" (headless, whole path, --setting-sources project)
build.result_tail: **Next steps:** Use `graphify query "<question>"` to explore the graph interactively, or examine specific communities in GRAPH_REPORT.md for detailed analysis.

terminal_result_usage.scope: the terminal result event as Claude Code reports it

coverage.population: dataset corpus pages (repository_source_path); source files on disk are a larger population, see the qmd record

arguments.question: <question text>
arguments.token_budget: default 2000, then 8000 when fewer than ten distinct pages came back

query_interface.node_to_file: each NODE line of the response, its src in the order the tool lists them, deduplicated; the [!] TRUNCATED marker at 8000 is the truncation
